tagline: Drucker取景器相机，1939 年发布
description: The Ranger is a viewfinder camera for sixteen 3x4 cm pictures on 127 film, made in about 1939 by Albert Drucker and Company of Chicago, although McKeown states that the camera was at first sold by Burke & James, for whom Drucker also worked (his brother George Drucker owned B&J).
